notes.title: Update Notes Feb
notes.notes:
I have been making some improvements while developing the upcoming roguelike sequel and I wanted to incorporate these improvements back into Battle for Esturia. Here is what is included in the latest update:

[list]
[*] HP/EP restored on level-up
[*] Enemy bones and party NPCs no longer block stairs after battle
[*] Added Scanlines as display option
[*] Added blood Splatter on enemy death 
[*] Added screen shake on damage 
[/list]

notes.title: Update for Feb 10
notes.notes: There was an error when writing files on windows during update. We are reverting the previous update until we can solve the windows write error.
